14.t: Working with data: patterns in group 1
q: Which metal has the highest melting point?
Describe the trend in melting point down the group.
Melting point decreases going down the group.
Predict the melting point of rubidium.
Describe the trend in reactivity and suggest why it is kept in oil.
Reactivity increases down the group. The metals react with water and oxygen in the air, so they are stored under oil to keep air and moisture away.
